summary: Iteration 40: tested Multi Account Clear ledgers, Staff ExportBar (Print/PDF/Excel) and Esc-closes-dialogs, end to end (backend + UI). Backend: test_multi_clear_v40.py ran 2x with ALL OK. Frontend checks that passed: Settings link / default banao / unlink / relink chips + multi hint, and the chips persist after Save Settings + reload. Rokad: settle-ledger-select shows up only when Account Settled is ticked, default is pre-selected and labelled '(default)', settle-info-ledger updates, toast names the chosen ledger, party balance is 0 with the cleared-upto marker, badge title shows '-> ledger'. Editing pre-selects the saved ledger; switching it moved the journal to the other ledger (confirmed in the register + API). Account Clear Register: 'Sab ledgers (2)' + each ledger; Ledger column in both the table and the DOS sheet; per-ledger filter hides the column and totals match (1000 = 700 + 300); Excel downloads. TB/OB: a separate +/- toggle on each linked head, sub rows only under the clicked head, group totals unchanged. Staff Attendance/Salary: btn-print/btn-pdf/btn-excel are present and old buttons are gone. window.print stub was called. Excel columns are as specified (attendance: 31 day columns + P/H/A/C/Din; salary: Staff..V.No.). Esc closed modal-pay-salary (also with focus in pay-deduct; no payment made), the salary slip, modal-staff (also from an input), transfer-modal and ledger-in-use-dialog, and the route did not change in any case. Esc with no modal open still does DOS back-navigation. No JS page errors. Only finding: an old print-orientation issue on the salary slip (see minor).

minor.issue: Leftover parties 'AC CLEAR ONE/TWO 1322F' and 'QA MULTI 1322F' (1000 Dr) were in the preview DB from an earlier E1 run of this test, probably an aborted run before cleanup. I deleted them. My 2 runs cleaned up correctly (all DELETE 200). Optional: move cleanup into try/finally.

ui_bugs.issue: The slip prints/PDFs as A4 LANDSCAPE, not portrait. triggerPrint() injects '@page{size:A4 portrait}' into <head>. But StaffSalary.jsx line 107 renders an inline <style>@media print{@page{size:A4 landscape}}</style> inside the body. That rule comes later in document order, so it wins. Verified with page.pdf(prefer_css_page_size=True) while the slip was open: MediaBox 842x595 (landscape). Electron printing.js uses preferCSSPageSize:true, so the desktop PDF preview is affected too. This existed before this iteration (the inline style is in earlier commits); it is not a regression. Fix: drop the inline @page from StaffSalary.jsx (triggerPrint already picks landscape for /staff/), or disable it while body.print-slip is set. The same inline pattern is in StaffAttendance, AccountClearReport, Outstanding, OpeningBalance, StaffReport.

design_issues.screen: Settings / Rokad / Account Clear / Staff month pickers
issues: These screens use the browser's native date/month inputs, not a styled calendar. This was already the case and matches the DOS style; mentioned only for awareness.

(Low) Make test_multi_clear_v40.py clean up in try/finally so a failed run doesn't leave AC CLEAR*/QA MULTI* parties in the shared DB.
critical_code_review_comments: useEscClose (capture phase + stopImmediatePropagation) works correctly with useEscapeBack (bubble + setTimeout + overlayOpen check). Verified: no route change when a modal is open.
SettleToggle reads /settings once on mount. If ledgers are unlinked in another tab while the form is open, the stale id is caught by the backend 400. Acceptable.

SettleToggle falls back to the default ledger when a saved settle_account_id is no longer linked. That edit silently moves the settlement to the default ledger with no warning shown; consider a small hint.
